market_summary: All six assets are currently trading within the Asian session chop window with automation blocked across the board. Gold, EURUSD, and GBPUSD are staging mild mean-reversion bounces toward their descending EMA50 baselines and upper ATR boundaries, but face immediate resistance without broad volume expansion. US100 remains rangebound around its CME Globex VWAP inside its Value Area. Silver displays erratic two-sided wick volatility despite high tick volume, and Bitcoin continues consolidating near session lows after testing lower ATR bounds. Across all symbols, confluence remains insufficient to override the session automation block, dictating a disciplined HOLD across the entire portfolio.
